Thanks for reading,

Messages.Author: brettscho
Messages.Body:
Welcome back! If you are looking for a local playgroup, you may want to check out the  list of Princes  (volunteers on a city/region level).

As for blood counters - there was a set of "official" ones that sound like what you describe, but they were made as prizes for tournaments and I don't think they are readily available any more. Really any counters you have will work great - I've seen people use pennies or bullet casings (likely easier to get over here in the Colonies...), cardboard markers, and those little beads that you can get at places like Target or pet stores (they go at the bottom of fish bowls often).

There is also an awesome rulebook that a VEKN volunteer put together recently (my understanding is it's not done yet, which is why it hasn't been posted here yet), but it's full sized, and has plenty of examples, I think it's a lot easier to read than those little rulebooks - plus it should be more complete and up-to-date.

Let me see if I can find the link... ah,  here it is !

There is also a pretty good demo document that walks you through a turn or two (it's be a good way to remind yourself about the game), which can be  found here .

And finally, there is a video done by the Gentleman Gamer which is a primer for how to play VTES on an online program called Lackey, but it also does a pretty decent job of explaining the rules, so you might find it useful. The video is posted below.

Enjoy, and again, welcome back to the game!

Brett
